paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +3.02% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (+6.51%) and Hang Seng weakest (+0.30%). Brent crude changed -6.81% to 86.27. Gold changed +3.63% to 3,643.0. Bitcoin changed -1.76% to 60,084.2695. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.918%, a relative move of +0.12%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (+8.09%) and Invesco (+6.90%) moved the most.
